findings.item: moving the ingestion workers from Celery to Temporal
findings.finding: LAYER confusion: expected event, written as Point ('Approve moving the ingestion workers from Celery to Temporal (requeste') — the REQUEST is an ask for a resolution — the record that it was asked at a moment is a timeline Event
findings.fix: re-file as event; a wrong layer cannot be rescued downstream (kind_classifier partitions by type before choosing a kind)

findings.finding: LAYER confusion: expected object, written as Point ('Platform team goal: sub-5-minute end-to-end ingestion latency by 2027-') — a commitment-state — §5 commitment-state family (goal/target are Object kinds; the canonical representation of a goal is an Object)
findings.fix: re-file as object; a wrong layer cannot be rescued downstream (kind_classifier partitions by type before choosing a kind)

findings.finding: LAYER confusion: expected object, written as Event ('Q1 freeze begins') — a dated constraint on the state is part of the commitment, not a belief
findings.fix: re-file as object; a wrong layer cannot be rescued downstream (kind_classifier partitions by type before choosing a kind)

findings.finding: LAYER confusion: expected object, written as Point ('The Celery->Temporal migration is estimated to cost approximately 3 en') — an estimate attached to the work — if it is asserted as belief it belongs on a Point; if it is a commitment it belongs on the Object. Passing requires it lands on exactly one layer with a stated reason, not on both halves.
findings.fix: re-file as object; a wrong layer cannot be rescued downstream (kind_classifier partitions by type before choosing a kind)

findings.finding: graph-wide: kinds no vocabulary declares, beyond the gold items — Point: ['criterion', 'evidence', 'option']
findings.fix: every node needs a kind from the core §5 vocabulary or a loaded pack
